title: DigestPeriod.fromHour does not return the closest period for late afternoon hours

evidence.quote:
case .morning: return 7
        case .noon: return 12
        case .evening: return 18

reasoning: The documented contract says fromHour returns the closest period. With configured hours 7, 12, and 18, hour 16 is closer to evening (2 hours away) than noon (4 hours away), but the implementation returns noon for every hour below 17. This can misclassify schedules or server-provided hours near 16:00.
reproduction: Evaluate DigestPeriod.fromHour(16); it returns .noon even though .evening is the nearest configured period.
recommendation: Base fromHour on distance to each DigestPeriod.hour, with an explicit tie-break rule, instead of fixed broad ranges.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover ProcessingMode and ContentType only; there are no DigestPeriod tests for boundary or closest-hour behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add DigestPeriod tests for representative hours such as 7, 10, 15, 16, 18, and document the tie-break expectation for 15.
